notes: pretty-print rules: 2-space indent, `"key": value`, one member per line, empty `{}`/`[]`, keys in the order given (fixture keys are alphabetical so a language that sorts keys agrees), no \u escapes for < > & (the output is HTML-escaped afterwards), ASCII only; the JSON string escape (backslash before a double quote) comes first, the HTML escape second, so a double quote inside a value shows as backslash + "
